description: Add JavaScript and CSS functionality to automatically add `target='_blank'` to external links in documentation pages. This should identify links that point outside the current documentation domain and open them in new tabs while providing visual feedback to users.
functional_requirements: Implement JavaScript logic to detect external links (links with href attributes pointing outside the current documentation domain)
Automatically add `target='_blank'` and `rel='noopener'` attributes to all identified external links
Add CSS styling to visually distinguish external links from internal documentation links
Ensure the solution works across all documentation pages without manual link-by-link updates
Include appropriate accessibility considerations (ARIA labels or other indicators for screen readers)
Test the implementation to verify it doesn't interfere with existing documentation functionality
